groupPlaceholder: Leave empty for no group, or pick an existing group
hint: Drag items to reorder them. Check several items and drag any one of them to move them together. Drop onto an item or header of another group to move them into that group
hintMobile: Use the arrows to reorder. Check several items to move them to a group at once
renamePrompt: New group name. Every item in the group is renamed with it and keeps its order; a name already in use merges the groups
nameTooLong: The group name cannot exceed {max} characters
mergeConfirm: Group "{to}" already exists. Merge "{from}" into it?
